comment: Where the tree-sitter resources come from and where they go. {arch} is the architecture of the device: aarch64, arm, x86_64 or x86. {home} is the app's home, /data/data/<package>/files/home (AppDirs). The root is where the resources go; a target is a directory below the root ("." is the root itself), or a path of its own that starts with {home} (the friendly-snippets of the completion, in {home}/lsp/friendly-snippets). A package owns the entries at the top of its zip (configs: config/ and themes/), and only those are replaced when it is updated.
